title: ClipHub
description: A universal clipboard web application that allows users to instantly share text and files across devices. It supports real-time collaboration, secure sharing with password protection, auto-expiry, and QR-based access for seamless cross-device communication.

title: LinkHub
description: A customizable web dashboard that enables users to organize, manage, and access their favorite websites from a single place. It features personalized dashboards, categorized links, drag-and-drop organization, widgets, and a modern responsive interface for a seamless browsing experience.

title: Green Hydrogen InfraVision
description: Green Hydrogen InfraVision is a full-stack, AI-powered geospatial platform that enables users to explore, analyze, and optimize green hydrogen infrastructure through interactive maps. It features real-time asset visualization, AI-driven site analysis, sustainability insights, and gamified infrastructure planning, helping users make data-informed decisions for future hydrogen ecosystems.

title: CampusConnect
description: CampusConnect is a full-stack University Management Portal that unifies students, faculty, and campus services into a single digital platform. It provides secure authentication, event and academic management, interactive campus navigation, QR-based services, file management, and real-time communication, delivering a seamless and connected campus experience.

title: ThreatLens AI
description: An AI-powered cyber threat intelligence platform for investigating URLs, Emails, QR codes, Phone Numbers, and Images using OSINT and AI-driven threat analysis.
